parent_objective: implement logging-only outcome metric fields required by revised task-quality semantics
blocked_by: revised-semantics execution needs recovery, drift, mitigation, boundary, and hidden-dynamics metric fields
supersedes: direct revised-semantics execution without metric instrumentation

public_gates: M1746 must not change reward dynamics termination actor observations policy checkpoints or profile masks
M1746 must add focused tests for all metric families defined by M1745
M1746 must not run the 864-cell rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout rank controller families or claim paper-level evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run full environment rollout

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements logging-only metrics needed before revised-semantics execution
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if implementation changes reward or termination behavior
stop if actor observation shape changes
stop if focused tests cannot cover every M1745 metric family
stop if full rollout is attempted before implementation audit
fallback_plan: route to implementation repair if tests fail
route to bounded-panel design if logging-only implementation becomes too broad
route to instrumentation result audit if implementation passes
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1745 admits logging-only metric instrumentation implementation

admission_evidence: M1745 defines all seven metric gaps and routes them to bounded logging-only instrumentation
blocked_shortcuts: do not change reward or termination behavior
do not claim paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
allowed_updates: M1746 documentation, status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; logging metrics cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: implementation should preserve profile controls but must not interpret metric fields as self-ID evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If metric implementation exposes missing telemetry, record instrumentation limitation rather than self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1745 outcome metric definitions can be implemented as logging-only evaluator/env instrumentation without changing actor, reward, termination, policy, profile, or training behavior.
success_criteria: logging-only fields for recovery drift mitigation off-track severity and hidden-dynamics aggregates are implemented
focused tests cover all M1745 metric families
actor observation reward termination policy checkpoint profile and training behavior remain unchanged
full rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout ranking and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: implementation changes reward termination dynamics actor observation or profile behavior
one or more M1745 metric families lacks focused tests
full rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
paper-level or level3 claims are made

commands.name: implementation
commands.command: implement logging-only outcome metric instrumentation and focused tests

decision_rule: M1746 passes if logging-only instrumentation and tests cover all M1745 metric definitions without changing policy behavior.
